architecture.name: Client-Server Architecture
architecture.description: WebSocket-based architecture for real-time multiplayer gameplay

architecture.name: Message-Driven Communication
architecture.description: WebSocket messages follow consistent naming patterns, server handlers organized by message type, event-driven frontend updates

architecture.name: Infrastructure as Code
architecture.description: Each service has its own `iac/` directory with CloudFormation YAML templates, deployment scripts, and environment configurations

architecture.name: Browser
architecture.description: The entry point for the application, interacting with the Vue/Vite client.

architecture.name: Vue/Vite client
architecture.description: The frontend application built with Vue 3 and Vite, communicating with a WebSocket endpoint.

architecture.name: WebSocket endpoint
architecture.description: A communication channel configured through VITE_WS_URL, connecting the client to the backend server.

architecture.name: Backend server
architecture.description: A server component (not present in the checkout) that interacts with DynamoDB and the WebSocket endpoint.

architecture.name: DynamoDB
architecture.description: A NoSQL database service used for data persistence, configured locally with DynamoDB Local.

architecture.name: CloudFront distribution
architecture.description: A content delivery network distribution serving the static client application and handling WebSocket-related headers.

architecture.name: Lambda@Edge basic authentication
architecture.description: A Lambda function associated with CloudFront to challenge requests with HTTP Basic authentication.

rules.name: kebab-case
rules.description: For file names, component names, and message types

rules.name: PascalCase
rules.description: For Vue components and TypeScript interfaces

rules.name: .ts/.js extensions
rules.description: TypeScript preferred, JavaScript for legacy word lists

rules.name: TypeScript and Vue single-file components
rules.description: Use TypeScript and Vue single-file components for client-side development.

rules.name: Code formatting
rules.description: Use two spaces, LF line endings, UTF-8, a final newline, no semicolons, single quotes, and a Prettier print width of 100.

rules.name: Path alias
rules.description: Use the `@/` alias for paths under `client/src/`.

rules.name: ESLint configuration
rules.description: Apply ESLint rules covering TypeScript, TSX, and Vue files, with specific configurations for Vue and Vitest.

rules.name: Unit testing
rules.description: Use Vitest with jsdom and Vue Test Utils for unit testing.

rules.name: Contribution guidelines
rules.description: Work against the latest `main`, check for existing issues/PRs, discuss significant work in an issue, keep pull requests focused, run local tests, and use clear commit messages.
